column3: Near-verbatim parallel: نهيت أن أعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله; adds البينات and submission to رب العالمين.
Confession after بأس; no distinct route to the focus beyond auxiliary resonance.
اتباع and اهتداء occur, but the universal messenger address is secondary to 6:56.

Affliction and تضرع add no direct worship-or-desire clarification.
